title: Sermo multiple content email optin win
industry: Physician social network and pharmaceutical marketing

change.control: Single-article email offer to a rented Fierce Pharma audience with an email capture popup after the download click.
change.variant: Offer several content choices within one email.

result.metric: email capture rate among prospects who clicked twice

significance.reported: Source reports a significant opt-in increase among people who clicked twice.

quote: increase email capture rate by 197% on their most qualified prospects.
notes: The reported increase applies only to twice-clicking prospects, not all recipients. Post-treatment selection may affect comparability. No sample counts or confidence supplied. Classified by pharmaceutical lead opt-in, not the physician community’s paid-access revenue.
